caption: The 2 KB request needs 3.2768 ms to push onto the 5 Mbps link, then 40 ms of one-way delay, so it reaches the server at 43.2768 ms. Delay, not link rate, sets the wait.

spec.title: Worked example: 2 KB UPI request, 5 Mbps link, 40 ms delay
spec.aria: A downward chain from the mobile host with a 2 KB request, through radio access at 5 Mbps, 3.2768 ms transmission, a highlighted 40 ms one-way delay, to the server at 43.2768 ms total.
